# Hisab Technical Services LLC

> Dubai HVAC contractor (DED licence 1229557, established 2023). Designs, supplies, installs and commissions split AC, VRF/VRV and ducted split air conditioning with ductwork for new buildings, towers and villas in Dubai and Sharjah, UAE. Free site inspection before every quote.

- Arabic name: حساب للخدمات الفنية ذ.م.م
- Phone / WhatsApp: +971 55 828 5372
- Email: hvac@hisabtechnical.com
- Area served: Dubai, Sharjah and the UAE (references in Sharjah, Al Dhaid, Umm Al Quwain and Dubai)
- Founders: Eng. Mohammad Rafique Attar (Founding Partner, more than 25 years in HVAC); Muhammad Saadat Shafqat, ACA (Co-Founder & Managing Director)
- Focus: new installations; maintenance for systems Hisab installed, during the warranty period
- Instagram: https://instagram.com/hisab_technical_services_llc
